user.title: Zodiac iAquaLink Heat Pump
user.description:
Sign in with your iAquaLink account and enter the heat pump serial number.

To find the serial: log in at the [iAquaLink website]({iaqualink_url}), open the location for your pool, then click **Device Status**. It is also printed on the sticker on the unit and looks like `{serial_example}`.

init.title: Zodiac iAquaLink polling interval
init.description:
The iAquaLink cloud API rate-limits aggressively. Polling too often causes HTTP 429 errors and stale/unavailable data.

- **Minimum recommended: 5 minutes.** 10-15 minutes is a safer default — 429s have been observed in real-world use even at 5 minutes.
- If you have **multiple** Zodiac/iAquaLink devices on the same account, the rate limit appears to be **account-wide**. Space out or raise each device's interval rather than running several at 5-10 minutes each.
- A stray 429 is not harmful: the integration reuses the last known reading for a few cycles before marking entities unavailable. A low interval with *sustained* 429s, however, means the data shown is effectively stale.
